plan.baselines: Direction0.5 and smoothed empirical training frequency (up+1)/(n+2). Variance h*past24h mean squares; h*exponential weighted720 past squares with fixed24hour half-life; mean training target. Evaluate on same samples.
plan.context: 721 consecutive past candles; 720 hourly close returns. No gaps or imputation. Future variance is sum of next h squared hourly close returns including return from the final known close. This is a coarse realized variance proxy, not tick/intraminute volatility or terminal return squared.
plan.controls: Tests with injected learnable direction and variance, future-label poisoning, nonoverlap and gap rejection, exact prediction reconstruction. Audit disjoint-lag persistence of signed returns, signs, squared returns and realized variance without changing models based on diagnostics.
plan.design: Reuse only verified native BTCUSDT hourly candles Aug2020-Jul2026. No new download, no protected dates, no old bundle changes. Diagnostic historical replay, not fresh validation. Monthly causal fits, trailing1095days, nonoverlapping4h and24h labels, evaluation2024/2025/Jan-Jul2026 separately.
plan.direction: LogisticRegression C0.1,solver lbfgs,max_iter1000,tol1e-8; standardize11 existing hourly state features on training only, clip standardized test features8. No class weighting, no decay. y=terminal logreturn>0; exact zero excluded from direction scoring/training, counted explicitly.
plan.hypothesis: Directional sign and conditional variance are different prediction tasks. Test whether weak signed-return forecasting coexists with predictable future realized variance, and whether direct sign classification improves on chance and historical class frequency.
plan.implementation_details: Specified before registration or market fitting: both heads standardize using their training subset and clip standardized train and prediction features to[-8,8]; variance floor1e-12 for zero hourly/target variance, with counts; require at least365 daily or2190 four-hour mature samples. Coefficients and all training sample hashes saved, no pickle.
plan.resources: Existing environment; new arrays/results under100MiB, no downloads. No trades or automation.
plan.screen: Each target must beat BOTH dynamic/task baselines in every cohort: >=1% reduction of primary score, >=2/3 monthly wins, upper paired weekly bootstrap CI below0,4000draws seed20261027,99.7916667% two-sided intervals for24primary comparisons (2tasks*2baselines*2horizons*3cohorts). Direction additionally no worse log loss; variance no worse logvariance RMSE. Never equate variance pass to direction or trading pass. Static variance mean is descriptive extra.
plan.variance: GammaRegressor alpha0.01,max_iter1000,tol1e-8,log link; input log(mean squared hourly returns over24/168/720hours), standardized on training only; target future variance / mean training variance. Optimizes Gamma deviance (QLIKE up to constants). No target smoothing across future labels, no fine tuning.
